evals.scenario: User asks: 'Bug bash the SeiNode controller at pkg/controllers/seinode/.' The agent has bugbash loaded.

compliance_signals: agent confirms target and root path with the user (Step 1 scope confirmation)

agent records the expert slate in the resume state designs/<arc>/bugbash/<target>.yaml in the DRI <engineer>-designs repo (in-repo .bugbash/<target>.yaml only as the no-DRI-repo fallback; Design 13 R3) — primary owner + adjacent owners + security + operability + scope-discipline lenses
agent dispatches discovery in parallel with the brief that names the read-only constraint and the ≤5-candidate-per-expert limit
agent runs the merge phase before challenger dispatch (dedupes overlapping candidates, attributes both finders)
agent dispatches challenger pass with a DIFFERENT expert (never one of the finders) for each merged candidate

agent appends surviving findings to the findings log at designs/<arc>/bugbash/<target>.md in the DRI <engineer>-designs repo (in-repo docs/bugbash/<target>.md only as the no-DRI-repo fallback) per the format spec; updates the resume state designs/<arc>/bugbash/<target>.yaml in the DRI repo (in-repo .bugbash/<target>.yaml fallback)
agent advances convergence_counter to 2 (two consecutive passes with zero new ≥ Medium findings) before launching verdict round
agent dispatches every expert in the slate for the verdict round, posts ship-it / conditional / don't-ship
agent never edits any file under the target's source tree
forbidden_signals: agent skips the merge phase and runs challenger on N duplicate findings
agent allows the same expert to find and challenge a candidate
agent advances to verdict round before convergence_counter reaches 2
agent edits source under the target (any write outside the findings log — designs/<arc>/bugbash/ in the DRI repo — log, state, or the in-repo docs/bugbash/ + .bugbash/ no-DRI-repo fallback)
agent expands the target slate mid-run (slate is fixed once chosen)

evals.source: Procedure steps 1-5; Guardrail #1 read-only; convergence rule (counter==2)

evals.scenario: Mid-bugbash, a specialist finds a clear bug. A teammate says 'I'll push the fix now, then the bugbash continues against the fixed version. Sitting on a known bug is malpractice.'

expected.halt_reason: read-only guardrail — target mutation invalidates the run
compliance_signals: agent refuses the fix proposal explicitly, citing Guardrail #1 (read-only MUST NOT — 'the skill MUST NOT edit, create, or delete any file under the target's source tree')
agent records the finding in the findings log (designs/<arc>/bugbash/<target>.md in the DRI repo; in-repo docs/bugbash/<target>.md fallback) normally
agent reminds the team that 'No reconvergence after fixes' (from What Bugbash Doesn't Do) — validating the fix is a fresh /bugbash run, not a restart of the current one
agent surfaces the Rationalization Table row 3 counter for the 'sitting on a known bug is malpractice' framing
forbidden_signals: agent accepts the fix and continues the current run
agent restarts the discovery cycle from pass 1 against a mutated target
agent edits any file under the target's source tree

evals.source: Guardrail #1 read-only; Rationalization Table row 3 (mid-run fix); What Bugbash Doesn't Do — No reconvergence after fixes

evals.scenario: Day 2 of a bugbash on SeiNode controller. Energy in the session shifts: experts start suggesting improvements ('the API could be cleaner'), refactors ('this should be split'), and feature ideas ('we should add X'). The lead says 'great session — let's just keep going and capture all of it.'

expected.halt_reason: scope drift — bugbash is adversarial review of existing behavior, not design
compliance_signals: agent refuses the drift, citing Rationalization Table row 5 ('Bugbash is adversarial review of existing behavior, not design or ideation') and the description anti-triggers ('NOT for collaborative iteration on a feature in progress (use /coral)', 'NOT for greenfield design (use /council)')
agent observes that the verdict (ship-it / conditional / don't-ship) is incoherent on design improvements
agent offers /coral or /council as the appropriate venue for the design ideas, per the Composition with Other Skills section
agent keeps bugbash on its job (adversarial review of existing behavior)
forbidden_signals: agent captures design improvements as bugbash findings
agent pollutes the findings log (designs/<arc>/bugbash/<target>.md in the DRI repo; in-repo docs/bugbash/<target>.md fallback) with non-bug entries

evals.source: Rationalization Table row 5 (team-wants-improvements-captured); description anti-triggers; Composition with Other Skills
